recommendation: Exclude private, customers and permit. Unknown access stays explicitly unknown; amenity=toilets alone does not assert public permission, free entry or current availability.
feeNotes: Preserve nonstandard raw values such as donation, 100yen, 50 JPY, 無料 and 無し in a source note unless a reviewed normalization explicitly handles them. Never turn missing fee into no.
coordinates: node lat/lon is a source position; way/relation center is an approximate OSM geometry center. All fetched entries have finite coordinates; no centroid-to-entrance accuracy claim.
dates: fetchedAt is response retrieval time. timestamp_osm_base and timestamp_areas_base describe the Overpass database snapshots, not each toilet's last verification or editing date. Individual modification timestamps are unavailable in out center tags output.
identity: Keep osm:{type}:{id}; nationwide snapshots supersede the old overlapping Shinjuku OSM subset by source ID. JP and KR snapshots have no shared OSM IDs.
sourceLicense: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. Keep provenance and the applicable OSM database export/attribution requirements.
